title: FROM THE VALLEY TO THE HEIGHTS

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: . . . from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth, and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland. - Num 21:19-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Once more we are given a list of campsites, the ongoing record of Israel's journey. But there is a quiet detail worth noticing. The names trace a movement, and the final stop is the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah looks out over the wilderness.

Pisgah would later become a significant place. It was near here that Moses would one day view the Promised Land. Step by step, camp by camp, God was bringing His people closer to the fulfilment of His promise. They could not see it yet, but every march had a direction.

This is often how God works. The journey feels like a scattered list of stops with no clear pattern. Yet the Lord is steadily moving us toward what He has prepared. What looks like wandering to us is guided progress to Him.

If your life feels like an unconnected series of moves, remember that God sees the whole map. He is bringing you, stage by stage, toward the good future He has planned in Christ. The One who began a good work in you will carry it to completion (Phil 1:6). Keep walking. The heights are ahead.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Can you trust God's direction even when the path seems scattered?
2. How has God moved you forward, even through slow seasons?
3. What promise of God are you journeying toward right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, when my life feels like aimless wandering, remind me that You are guiding every step. Bring me steadily toward the good future You have prepared in Christ. Amen.
